a: AWS covers the cost of storing and sharing the dataset on the Registry of Open Data on AWS (in-kind; no dollar cap stated)
dt: Rolling; AWS says decisions are generally sent within two weeks
e: Covers cloud storage and data-transfer costs for publicly available, openly licensed, cloud-optimized datasets (for example a survey or timing-array data release) listed on the Registry of Open Data on AWS. Data providers apply; applications are judged on accessibility, cloud readiness, community engagement and demand.
unv: The page names 'data providers' as applicants and does not say whether individual faculty or postdocs (rather than an institution or collaboration) may apply, or list citizenship limits; no award size is stated.
